title: Bridge command (one line of queue_<side>.jsonl)
description: Written by the host, run by the game. docs/contracts/bridge-protocol.md.

seq.description: Strictly increasing per side; microseconds since 1970 or last+1 (fits a Lua double exactly).

id.description: Unique per command; names the answer file.

ui.description: Run inside Ext.UI.Defer (client only); false when absent.

class.description: The class of a test's step: a verb the chunk calls that the class does not allow is refused (GK.Verbs). Absent: nothing is refused.
